paper.title: Network Structure and the Aggregation of Information: Theory and Evidence from Indonesia

paper_reference.paper_question: 社区掌握分散的贫困信息，网络结构如何影响信息聚合与定向瞄准效果？
paper_reference.target: 八户在“每村核实一户”与“村甲核实两户、村乙核实两户”各 1/2 的随机政策下，家底被摸清的平均比例；八户等权。
paper_reference.source_location: Alatas et al. (2016) AER 106(7):1663-1704, DOI 10.1257/aer.20140705. Section IIA, Table 4 (pp. 1676-1679) for accuracy decaying with network distance; Section V, Table 10 (pp. 1697-1700) for diffusiveness and targeting; Table 1 (p. 1673) for connectivity; Section IIIA (pp. 1680-1682) for the model. Project-built scenario; the paper does not pose this question.
conditions: Two complete verification lists with known probabilities 1/2 each.
Assignment independent of true poverty status and of the pre-treatment network.
Observed outcome corresponds to the executed list.
Network among the eight households fixed before verification.
Rule: verified own household, or at least one verified neighbour, counts as informed; otherwise not informed.
what_paper_supports: Dispersed community information on neighbours' poverty as business context.
Accuracy of that information decays with network distance (Section IIA, Table 4; descriptive, not causal).
Network diffusiveness changes the relative performance of community targeting versus PMT (Section V, Table 10).
what_paper_does_not_support: No claim that distance 1 implies full knowledge: the paper reports probability differences, the case collapses them to 0/1.
No modelling of noise: paper error rates are 0.46-0.52 with 0.19 don't know.
No replication of the semi-Bayesian learning model or the structural estimation.
No replication of the Table 10 interaction regression; beta_C is not the answer.
No claim that eight households in two villages represent 631 communities.
No extrapolation to optimal verification lists in real villages.

missing_condition.reason: The probabilities of the two verification lists are omitted; the fact layer stops with EXTENDED_NETWORK_FACTS_INCOMPLETE.

changed_target.reason: Evaluation population moves to the four households of village B; target and weights must be rebound.

actual_run.provenance: 2026-11-16 local structured run through the extended network finite-policy entry with explicit synthetic reviews; api_calls=0.
actual_run.note: 三个变体均在本地结构化运行；不调用 LLM；不读取公开材料以外的参考内容。

notes: Scenario adaptation; the paper does not pose this question. The outcome records whether a household's circumstances become known, not whether the judgement is correct, so it applies uniformly to poor and non-poor households. Peer exposure enters the target: a household is informed if it is verified or has at least one verified neighbour, and dropping the edge set leaves the target undefined. The changed_target evaluates the four households of village B at weight 1/4 each.
